nodes.name: POST /api/automation/wp-draft
nodes.notes: Idempotent via decideWpDraft() — same run_id returns the same wp_post_id. status is hard-coded 'draft' by the server. NEVER publish from this workflow.

nodes.name: POST /api/automation/media
nodes.notes: Phase 18C.1: uses the dedicated automation-authenticated media route (x-automation-secret only, no admin cookie/CSRF). Underlying WP upload is delegated to WordPressWriteClient.uploadMedia (same helper used by the admin media route; no duplicate upload code). This node never publishes.

nodes.name: Validate editorial fields
nodes.notes: Phase 18G: stop safely if title_th/body_th missing. Production safety — never create a WordPress post with empty body.

nodes.name: Promote FF90-04 output
nodes.notes: Phase 18G: terminal promote. wp_post_status is hardcoded 'draft' — server enforces this in wp-draft route.
